sketches.mechanism: A variable declared with the register storage class is forbidden from having its address taken.
sketches.resonance: The self kept closest to the machine becomes the one that cannot be located.

sketches.mechanism: Linked processes propagate abnormal exits to each other unless they explicitly trap exits.
sketches.resonance: A bond turns another process's death into your own termination.
sketches.draft:
-module(grief).
-export([main/0]).

main() ->
    Pid = spawn_link(fun() -> receive after infinity -> ok end end),
    exit(Pid, kill),
    receive after infinity -> ok end.

sketches.mechanism: ARC zeroes weak references automatically when the last strong reference to an object is released.
sketches.resonance: What refuses to possess cannot keep the beloved from becoming nil.
